title: Conformal Margins for Electrical Transmission Capacity Under Fixed Balancing Policies
summary: This article presents a data-driven approach to minimally adjust forecast-based steady-state generation dispatch in electrical transmission networks. The goal is to manage congestion caused by uncertainty in demand and renewable generation under a fixed automatic generation control (AGC) policy operating without saturation. Under this policy, we first show that the post-AGC residual injection distribution is invariant to the scheduled generation dispatch.
